narrative.intro: Whiting Turner Contracting Company the recorded $157M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. The company won 4 awards so far, with an average award size of $39.3M. Obligations fell 84.5% year over year. Historical fiscal-year obligations show a peak at $1B in FY26, with prior years at $611M in FY25, $503M in FY24, $675M in FY23, and $355M in FY22. The Department of Homeland Security is the dominant buyer in FY2027 to date, accounting for $155M of obligations. The National Gallery of Art accounted for $2.3M and the General Services Administration accounted for $11.6K. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market by NAICS in FY2027 to date at $155M, followed by All Other Specialty Trade Contractors at $2.3M. Current-year totals are fiscal year to date and represent partial year obligations. Award-value versus obligation distinctions follow the presented tables: the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values rather than obligation amounts.
